title: There is Something Quite Sinister About Palm Trees
excerpt: Words have been written, Stills have been shot
body:
Words have been written
Stills have been shot
People walk all about
Yet rarely stand tall
They tell me what my name means
Tell me what my sign says
Speak of their dreams
Nearly burst at the seams
Untrusting of time
They forget to just be
Going out west
Is dangerous for the weak
Talking to strangers
Searching for leaders under palm trees
I know the pleasures
Fruit ripe as can be
I’ve felt the sun
Been places one should not see
I’ve asked the questions
How I’ve forgotten to breath
Been witness to worlds
You couldn’t bare to believe
Precautions least-explored
Afraid excitement won’t always lead to more
Would you rather be hated or ignored?
Have you ever seen someone fully alive and waiting to be born?
